skill: When an allied shikigami takes lethal damage, restores HP to 20% and the onmyoji shares the excess damage (this effect can be trigged up to 3 times.) When the Onmyoji's HP is 50% or below, Soul Edge attacks all enemies, dealing 100% daamge and increasing all allies damage by 30% for 2 turns. Cooldown: 2 turns.
